events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture, took place in Bethel, New York in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music. What's your favourite Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away in Memphis, Tennessee in 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us 49 years ago today. His music and legend live on.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas, Nevada in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's enduring legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year, a trailblazer whose words continue to resonate. His impact on hip-hop is undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London, England in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and its famous cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road iconic album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released this month in 1969. That iconic zebra crossing shot and those timeless tracks – pure genius.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born in Akron, Ohio in 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and frontwoman of The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, was born in Manchester, England in 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll energy. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine's lasting message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that continues to inspire hope and peace around the world.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced its revolutionary portable music player, the iPod, in 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple dropped the first iPod and changed music consumption forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the premiere of the first film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 64 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born in Liverpool, England in 1940.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, legendary comedian, actor, and writer, was born in Weston-super-Mare, England in 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British treasure.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968, showcasing their diverse musical styles.

angles.name: White Album experimental sound
angles.copy: 58 years of The Beatles' 'White Album'! A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sounds incredible today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away in London, England in 1991.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic shift.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's influence
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your top pick from it?
